name: Fujikawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Fujikawa town emblem in green and blue: a disc of green and blue wavy strokes.
history: Municipal flag of Fujikawa, a town in Yamanashi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 March 2010.

features.role: Fujikawa town emblem — a disc of green and blue wavy strokes
